title: 8 Best Cash Management Software Tools in 2026
summary: Compare the 8 best cash management software tools in 2026, from Kyriba and Trovata to AI agents like Concourse, by fit, automation depth, and cost.
body_markdown:
Cash is the one thing a business cannot run out of, and yet most finance teams see it late, through stale spreadsheets stitched together from bank portals. **Cash management software** fixes that: it aggregates balances across banks in near real time, forecasts the cash the business will have, and helps put idle cash to work. The category runs from enterprise treasury suites to AI agents that run the cash work across your existing systems.


This guide compares the eight best cash management software tools in 2026 across the criteria that decide fit: cash visibility, forecasting, automation depth, and cost. For the narrower jobs within it, see our guides to[cash positioning software](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/best-cash-positioning-software) and the[best cash forecasting tools](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/best-cash-forecasting-tools) .


## **What is the best cash management software?**


> The best cash management software depends on your scale and bottleneck. Concourse is the pick for teams that want AI agents to run the cash work, forecasting, positioning, variance, and reporting, across their existing systems with every number traceable to source. For enterprise treasury and liquidity it is Kyriba; for modern multi-bank visibility, Trovata; for enterprise treasury with modern payments, GTreasury; for AI cash forecasting at high volume, HighRadius; for mid-market collections and forecasting, Tesorio; for explainable, driver-based forecasting, Nilus; and for European mid-market teams, Embat.


> **Concourse is the AI-agent option on this list.** Rather than a dashboard to interpret, Concourse deploys finance agents that connect to your ERP, data warehouse, and banking data and run cash workflows end to end: building and refreshing cash forecasts, tracking positions, running variance analysis, and producing liquidity reporting, with every output traceable back to source and a human approving.


## **Why teams invest in cash management software**


- **Cash visibility.** Aggregating balances across banks and entities into one current view, instead of logging into portals.
- **Forecasting.** Predicting the cash the business will have so leadership can plan and avoid surprises.
- **Liquidity optimization.** Putting idle cash to work and avoiding unnecessary borrowing.
- **Reporting.** Producing the cash and liquidity reporting the board and treasury need, on a schedule.


The honest framing: the tools below span a spectrum. Some are full enterprise treasury systems with deep bank connectivity; others are focused cash-visibility or forecasting tools; and AI agents run the recurring cash work across whatever systems you already have.


## **How we evaluated cash management software**


- **Cash visibility.** How well it aggregates balances across banks and entities, and how current the view is.
- **Forecasting.** Accuracy and method, and how easily you can explain a forecast.
- **Automation depth.** Whether it executes the work or mainly reports on it.
- **Bank connectivity.** How many banks it connects to and how automatically.
- **Auditability.** Whether every figure traces back to source.
- **Fit and cost.** Ideal company size and how heavy the implementation is.

## **The 8 best cash management software tools in 2026**


### **1. Concourse, Best for AI Agents That Run the Cash Work**


Concourse is an AI agent platform for corporate finance. Instead of another cash dashboard, it connects to your ERP, data warehouse, and banking data and runs cash workflows across them: building and refreshing cash forecasts, tracking positions, running variance analysis, and producing liquidity reporting on a schedule.


The difference is the execution model. Concourse does not ask you to move cash management into a new system of record; its agents work across the tools you already run, and every output traces back to source data and is validated against evals built for your business. It meets teams inside ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, Teams, and email, exports to Excel and PowerPoint, reports customer results including a 75% reduction in manual work and 20+ hours saved per user per month, is SOC 2 Type II certified, and connects to 100+ systems including NetSuite, QuickBooks, Snowflake, Salesforce, and Stripe.


**Best for.** Finance teams that want AI agents to run cash forecasting, positioning, and reporting across their existing stack, with full traceability.


**Keep in mind.** Concourse is an agent layer, not a bank-connectivity-and-payments TMS. For SWIFT or host-to-host payment rails and multi-bank account administration, run it alongside a dedicated TMS.


### **2. Kyriba, Best for Enterprise Treasury and Liquidity**


Kyriba is the most widely deployed enterprise treasury and liquidity platform, with deep bank connectivity, payments, risk, and cash management at global scale. It[reports serving more than 3,000 clients and processing over $15 trillion in payments annually](https://www.kyriba.com/news/kyriba-launches-its-open-api-platform/) .


**Best for.** Large multinationals that need cash management inside a full enterprise TMS.


**Keep in mind.** It carries enterprise cost and a months-long implementation. See our[Kyriba pricing](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/kyriba-pricing) and[Kyriba alternatives](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/kyriba-alternatives) guides.


### **3. Trovata, Best for Modern Multi-Bank Visibility**


Trovata is a cloud, API-native platform focused on real-time multi-bank cash visibility, reporting, and AI/ML forecasting, giving teams current cash visibility without a full legacy TMS. Third-party trackers report a[base package around $24,000 per year](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/trovata-pricing) .


**Best for.** Midsize-to-large companies that want modern, quick-to-deploy multi-bank cash visibility.


**Keep in mind.** The base caps at one bank and ten users, and depth in complex risk scenarios trails the enterprise incumbents.


### **4. GTreasury, Best for Enterprise Treasury Plus Payments**


GTreasury is a long-established enterprise TMS combining cash forecasting, bank connectivity, and risk. In late 2025,[Ripple acquired GTreasury for $1 billion](https://ripple.com/ripple-press/ripple-breaks-into-corporate-treasury-with-gtreasury-acquisition/) , pairing it with a modern payments network.


**Best for.** Mid-market to enterprise treasuries that want a full TMS with a forward path into modern payments.


**Keep in mind.** It is a heavier enterprise platform, and the Ripple integration is still maturing.


### **5. HighRadius, Best for AI Cash Forecasting at Volume**


HighRadius pairs order-to-cash automation with AI-driven cash forecasting, strong for high-transaction-volume environments. It[raised a $300M Series C at a $3.1B valuation in 2021](https://www.highradius.com/about/news/highradius-raises-300m-series-c-at-over-3-billion-valuation/) .


**Best for.** High-volume mid-market and enterprise teams whose priority is AI cash-forecasting accuracy.


**Keep in mind.** It is enterprise-scoped and priced, and strongest when paired with its order-to-cash suite.


### **6. Tesorio, Best for Mid-Market Cash and Collections**


Tesorio pairs cash-flow forecasting with accounts receivable and collections automation, aimed at mid-market and B2B SaaS teams. Founded in 2015, it[raised a $17M Series B in 2022](https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/93257/accounts-receivable-management-platform-tesorio-raises-17m) .


**Best for.** Mid-market teams that want cash forecasting tied to collections.


**Keep in mind.** It is narrower than enterprise treasury suites, focused on the receivables side of cash.


### **7. Nilus, Best for Explainable Forecasting**


Nilus is an AI-native treasury and cash platform built for forecasts teams can *explain* , tied to drivers and concrete actions rather than a black-box number, positioned for PE-backed and multi-entity teams.


**Best for.** PE-backed and multi-entity organizations that need explainable, policy-driven liquidity decisions.


**Keep in mind.** It is a newer, narrower platform, so validate coverage for your specific bank and ERP mix.


### **8. Embat, Best for European Mid-Market**


Embat is a modern European platform for cash visibility, forecasting, reconciliation, and payments, serving[400+ corporate clients across Europe](https://fintech.global/2026/05/12/embat-raises-e30m-series-b-to-drive-european-growth/) and connecting to thousands of banks.


**Best for.** European mid-market and PE-backed teams that want a regionally strong cash platform.


**Keep in mind.** It is strongest in Europe, with less-proven global-scale coverage.


*Also worth a look:* Mesh and Vesto for modern cash operations, and BILL for SMB cash and payments.


## **Which cash management software is right for you?**


- **Choose Concourse** if you want AI agents to *run* cash forecasting, positioning, and reporting across the systems you already have, with every number traceable.
- **Choose Kyriba or GTreasury** if you need cash management inside a full enterprise TMS.
- **Choose Trovata** if you want modern, quick-to-deploy multi-bank visibility.
- **Choose HighRadius** if AI forecasting accuracy at high volume is the priority.
- **Choose Tesorio** if you want cash forecasting tied to collections.
- **Choose Nilus** if explainable, driver-based forecasting matters most.
- **Choose Embat** if you are a European mid-market team.


The pattern across 2026 is that the strongest cash stacks pair a connectivity-and-payments layer with an agent layer that runs the forecasting, analysis, and reporting on top.


## **Frequently asked questions**


### **What is cash management software?**


Cash management software gives finance teams real-time visibility into cash across banks and entities, forecasts future cash, and helps optimize liquidity. It ranges from enterprise treasury systems to focused cash-visibility tools to AI agents that run the cash work across your existing systems.


### **What is the best cash management software?**


It depends on scale. Kyriba and GTreasury lead enterprise treasury, Trovata leads modern multi-bank visibility, and HighRadius leads AI forecasting at volume. For teams that want AI agents to run cash forecasting, positioning, and reporting across their existing systems, Concourse is the strongest AI-agent option.


### **What is the difference between cash management and treasury management software?**


Cash management focuses on visibility, forecasting, and optimizing cash and liquidity. Treasury management software is broader, adding payments, bank connectivity, debt, investments, and risk. Many treasury platforms include cash management as a core module; see the[best treasury management software](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/best-treasury-management-software-2026) .


### **Does cash management software include forecasting?**


Yes. Forecasting is a core part of cash management software, predicting the cash the business will have so teams can plan liquidity. Some tools specialize in it; AI agents like Concourse build and continuously refresh forecasts from live data. See the[best cash forecasting tools](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/best-cash-forecasting-tools) .


## **The bottom line**


There is no single best cash management software, because cash management spans visibility, forecasting, and optimization at very different scales. Match the tool to your bottleneck and size: an enterprise TMS for deep connectivity, a modern tool for multi-bank visibility, or an AI-agent layer that runs the recurring cash work across the systems you already have.
